description: The primary action on the welcome screen: 'Create an account'. Gradient-filled button matching the auth-screen (register) primary button language, tokenized. Navigates to the register screen. Replaces the old flat #7c3aed button.

designSystem.surface: LinearGradient with gradients.primaryGradient ([colors.primary, colors.primary2]), start {x:0,y:0} end {x:1,y:1}

loading.description: In-flight navigation; dims to opacity 0.6 and blocks re-tap

stateTreatments.disabled: opacity 0.6, block re-tap while navigation in flight (mirrors register 'submitting')

accessibility.label: Create an account
accessibility.colorIndependence: distinguished from secondary by gradient fill + arrow icon + position, not color alone
